title: A Level Negative Three Player Just Wrecked The Strongest Temple In The Game . . . (Episode 1)
caption:
A level negative three player just wrecked the strongest temple in the game. 😱 Overgeared, episode 1. Follow for episode 2!

#overgeared #anime #animerecap #animeexplained #recap #fyp
comment: Would you have opened the legendary book, or handed it in? Tell me below!

segments.say: A player with *negative* three levels just brought down the strongest temple in the game.
To see how it got here, go back to a quest nobody should have *taken*.
Grid is a level 73 warrior in Satisfye, the biggest VR game on *earth*.
It has two billion players, and the gold you earn goes straight to your real *bank* account.
But Grid is broke, and he is stuck on a secret S-rank *quest*.
The quest is meant for level 300 players, and he is level *73*.
He will not quit. If he pushes the limits, he can make a *fortune*.
At last he finds a strange item, but it costs sixty thousand yen to *identify*.
He pays anyway, and out comes a *legendary* book.
It belongs to Pogma, a master blacksmith, and opening it makes Grid his *successor*.
Grid is thrilled. The quest says to hand the book to the quest *giver*.
But Grid is greedy. On the market, it could sell for tens of *millions*.

segments.text: You're worth all I've spent on this game!

segments.say: Big mistake. The quest turns into Earl Asher's Wrath, an SS *rank*.
The earl calls him a traitor and sends his men to *kill* him.
Grid has one way out. He opens the *book*.
His class becomes Pogma's Successor, and every blacksmith skill is *his*.
A new stat appears, and Grid feels the *power* surging inside him.
He turns on the guards, ready to take them *all*. But he *dies* first.
Failing the quest drops his level, and Grid is now level *negative* one.
In the game company's boardroom, the executives study the *accident*.
They find his name is Grid, and he is just a normal 25-year-old from *Japan*.
No top player has ever found this class. Not one of the *best*.
Their supercomputer said it would stay hidden for two more *years*.
And the negative level hides a *secret*. Every level he regains gives bonus stat points.
The executives smile. Is this really just *chance*?
Meanwhile, Takumi wakes up tired and broke, and his sister Sarah is *furious*.
His parents run a shop, and they want him to stop gaming and *work* there.
But Takumi is busy watching a streamer, Yura the Blood *Witch*.
She is a model and a game celebrity, the complete opposite of *him*.
After a long shift, he gets paid, just enough for his student loans and the game *fee*.
He feels like a failure. He was bullied in school, and he wanted to get *rich* to prove them wrong.
He thinks about quitting. Then he remembers his legendary class, and gives it one last *shot*.
Takumi logs back in. His level is still *negative* one.
His stats are trash, but his old level 60 gear still *works*.
Then he stumbles into Yatan Temple, a level 150 *dungeon*.
Inside, hooded cultists are chanting a cursed *ritual*.
Before he can run, a warrior named Dorian grabs *him*.
Dorian says the earl's daughter Irene was *kidnapped*, and he needs help.
Grid refuses. But the system hands him an S-rank quest *anyway*.
The cultists spot them, and now there is no *escape*.
Dorian cuts through them, and Grid hopes to ride the *quest*.
Then Yura the Blood Witch appears, level 230, and challenges *Dorian*.
Dorian cannot land a single hit on *her*.
Only an ancient family ring can block her *curses*.
He knows he cannot win, so he tells Grid to take Irene and *run*.

segments.text: But I must. One day you'll understand.

segments.say: Grid tries to leave, but the cultists are *faster*.
Then comes Dark Storm, and Grid is *dead*.
But somehow, he still has one HP *left*.
His class has an immortality *bonus*.
He survives, but the *temple* does not.
He dies twice in one day, so his level falls to negative *three*.
Then he is locked out for twelve *hours*.
When he wakes, the whole game is talking about a *collapse* at Yatan Temple.
Grid learns he is now *famous*, the mysterious Temple Wrecker.

segments.text: Yeah, it's Grid. Yeah, it's negative three.

segments.say: Dorian is gone, and so is his legendary *ring*.

segments.text: I'm the legendary blacksmith now. If I want one, I can make it.

segments.say: A negative level, a blacksmith's hands, and a world that has no idea what is *coming*.
